Dear Sir/Madam

Re: Mrs. Julia Smith, aged 21 years

newborn of 30 weeks gestation. Further management of the mother and admitting her newborn to the              Comment [OET1]: , who has given birth

100% cervical effacement and the fetal station was at+4. Please note, the CTG was stable, hydralazine
was stopped and the baby was delivered at 9:10 am.
